description: Fluent 2 design system compliance rules — token usage, FluentProvider, JSX pragma, Field wrapping, and style patterns

tokens.description: Design token usage — alias tokens only, never hardcoded values or global imports

rules.description: No hardcoded hex color values in Fluent component files — use alias tokens
rules.message: Use alias tokens instead of hardcoded hex values (e.g., tokens.colorNeutralForeground1 not '#242424'). Hardcoded colors break dark/high-contrast themes.
rules.design_check: Does any component use hardcoded hex color values? All colors must come from tokens.* alias tokens so they adapt to light, dark, and high-contrast themes automatically.

rules.description: Never import from @fluentui/tokens/global — use alias tokens from @fluentui/tokens
rules.message: Import from '@fluentui/tokens' (alias layer), never from '@fluentui/tokens/global'. Global tokens bypass theming and produce hardcoded values.
rules.design_check: Are global tokens imported directly? Use: import { tokens } from '@fluentui/tokens' — the alias layer that adapts to all themes.

provider.description: FluentProvider setup — required at app root for token resolution

rules.description: FluentProvider must be present at application root
rules.message: Ensure FluentProvider wraps your app root. Without it, all token references produce blank values: <FluentProvider theme={webLightTheme} dir="ltr" lang="en-US"><App /></FluentProvider>
rules.design_check: Is FluentProvider wrapping the app root with a theme, dir, and lang prop? Missing FluentProvider causes all design tokens to resolve to blank values.

component_pattern.description: 5-file component pattern compliance — JSX pragma, assertSlots, styles file naming

rules.description: render*.tsx files must include both @jsxRuntime automatic and @jsxImportSource pragmas
rules.design_check: Does every render*.tsx file include both @jsxRuntime automatic and @jsxImportSource @fluentui/react-jsx-runtime pragma comments?

rules.description: Use assertSlots instead of deprecated getSlots in render functions
rules.message: Replace getSlots with assertSlots. getSlots is deprecated and removed in v10. assertSlots provides TypeScript type narrowing: assertSlots<ButtonSlots>(state)
rules.design_check: Does any render function use getSlots? Replace with assertSlots<SlotType>(state) which provides type narrowing and is not deprecated.

forms.description: Form input wrapping — Field component required for all form controls

rules.description: Form inputs must be wrapped in Field for automatic ARIA wiring
rules.message: Wrap form inputs in <Field> instead of manually setting aria-label. Field auto-wires: label→htmlFor, hint→aria-describedby, validationMessage→aria-invalid. Example: <Field label="Email"><Input type="email" /></Field>
rules.design_check: Are any form inputs (Input, Textarea, Combobox, etc.) used without a Field wrapper? Field auto-wires all ARIA attributes — label→htmlFor, hint→aria-describedby, validationMessage→aria-invalid.

styling.description: Griffel CSS-in-JS required — no inline styles on Fluent components

rules.description: Never use inline styles on Fluent components — use makeStyles or makeResetStyles
rules.message: Use makeStyles/makeResetStyles instead of inline styles on Fluent components. Inline styles override slot className and cannot be overridden by consumers downstream.
rules.design_check: Are inline styles applied to any Fluent component? Use makeStyles for variants and makeResetStyles for base styles — inline styles on Fluent components break the override chain.
